previousDevelopmentCoverage.qualification: Exact stable file/project/full-title passing union across the listed frozen-input reports. Each failed run retains its diagnostic outcome; overlapping passes are deduplicated, not relabeled as a whole-cohort pass.

historicalBaseline.qualification: The original 700-case passing union is historical. This successor does not claim a new complete development cohort.
historicalBaseline.diagnostic: The previous actual-App captures used Help fallback artwork for Grow/Shrink. Their recorded geometry/readiness remains historical evidence; this packet corrects the icon resolution and adds actual SVG assertions.

nativeReuse.qualification: Five publication leaves, native contract/source evidence and linked invocation artifacts match prior bytes. Native mains were not newly invoked and no native compilation is claimed for this icon successor.

scope.behavior: Grow/Shrink artwork resolves from the verified current desktop supplement ahead of the legacy 73-icon palette; joined control behavior/geometry remains qualified by the new focused tests.
scope.currentBrowserAcceptance: 27 focused cases (21 morphology + six Settings), plus a separate 66-case production cohort. Counts overlap historical coverage and are not added to it.

memoryAndPublication.classification: conservative bounded operation policy, not an exact allocator/census/heap quota
memoryAndPublication.nativePublicationOverlap: scratch + owner + transaction history copies + 8*K Changes + N COW mask + actual deque append/map growth
memoryAndPublication.laterJsGpuOverlap: input ArrayBuffer N + source slice N + expanded Uint32 data 4*N + candidate GPU mask 4*N; existing render owners remain charged
memoryAndPublication.qualification: Scratch retires before browser mask staging. Real native grants enforce actual admitted payload; transaction-copy/deque metadata, allocator headers/control blocks, exceptions, fragmentation, JS GC, browser/driver staging and retained WASM page growth are not invented as an exact closed bound.

publication.workerPump: src/workers/editPump.ts yields real MessageChannel tasks before traversal batches; each native step requests 4096 work units, each batch stops after 8 ms or 256 steps even with a frozen/coarse clock, and cancellation is checked before every step and before progress publication.
publication.synchronousFinalStep: O(N + K): O(K) sparse validation/conversion/history application plus potential O(N) mask COW
publication.qualification: Cooperative traversal is implemented. Final publication remains synchronous; no blanket browser responsiveness or performance acceptance is asserted.

scope.acceptance: Exact current explicit input/artifact records and observed terminal reports; serial local browser execution at each report scope.

limitations: No new full 700-case development run is claimed. The original failed full run, corrected passing union and diagnostic artifacts remain in the rehashed historical archive.
